title: The Blood Furnace
body: The Blood Furnace lies deep inside Hellfire Citadel, a wing of halls and cell blocks that the Fel Horde guards well. Shadowmoon warlocks tend it beside felguards and imps, a mo'arg demon called the Maker works there like a craftsman at his bench, and orc captives fill its cells. In its chambers wait nascent fel orcs, new to their red skins and eager for blood, and through the halls goes up the cry that the blood is their power.

parts.body: Honor Hold and Thrallmar want vials of fel orc blood. If they knew how the fel orcs are made, they might find a way to stop it, or even to reverse it.
sources: zones/blood_furnace.txt (map 542: area 3713 only)

parts.body: They have a pit lord. The fel orcs are made from its blood, a new breed not aligned with the Legion, and what was done to the orcs of Draenor could be done to any orc at all.
sources: zones/blood_furnace.txt (map 542: area 3713 only)

title: Keli'dan the Breaker
body: Keli'dan the Breaker, a fel orc sorcerer, holds the deepest chamber of the Blood Furnace. He does not stand guard so much as stand at work: in the middle of a ring of five Shadowmoon channelers he keeps a ritual burning, his whole attention bent on it, and he warns those who interrupt that they will ruin everything.
sources: boss_kelidan_the_breaker.cpp (Evocation while out of combat; the five Shadowmoon Channelers 17653 around him; he joins the fight once they are dead)
